svg.aria-label: Where the poles sit decides stability: poles in the left half-plane give a decaying response (stable), poles on the imaginary axis a constant oscillation (marginally stable), poles in the right half-plane a growing response (unstable)
svg.title: Where the poles sit decides stability: poles in the left half-plane give a decaying response (stable), poles on the imaginary axis a constant oscillation (marginally stable), poles in the right half-plane a growing response (unstable)
